verdict.rationale: A repository agent-readiness report is a fair capability for an autonomous coding agent, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows that Jules reads an AGENTS.md file and runs tasks in a VM, which is an adjacent behavior. Nothing documents a report that evaluates how ready a repository is for agents.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents
